SecretClient.description: Configuration for Azure Key Vault Secrets client.

VaultUri.description: The URI to the vault on which the client operates. Appears as "DNS Name" in the Azure portal.

DisableChallengeResourceVerification.description: Disable verification that the authentication challenge resource matches the Key Vault domain.

EnableProofOfPossession.description: Request Proof-of-Possession (PoP) token binding for authenticated requests. Opt-in; defaults to false.
